name: Armor Class
description: AC determines how difficult a creature is to hit. Armor, shields, and features determine the calculation.

name: Weapon Properties
description: Weapons can have properties such as finesse, heavy, light, reach, thrown, loading, and two-handed that modify how they are used.

name: Improvised Weapons
description: An object not designed as a weapon can be used to attack; DM determines resemblance to existing weapons and appropriate damage.

name: Carrying Capacity
description: Carrying capacity is Strength score multiplied by 15 pounds; push, drag, or lift up to twice that weight.
